asset_kind.description: Deliverable category in a few words, for example poster, article cover, social card, invitation, label, album cover.

canvas_statement.description: One opening sentence that names the deliverable, states the aspect ratio and orientation, and reserves the main layout zones before any surface detail. Budget: at most 240 characters; it is one sentence, not a second prompt.

prompt.description: One self-contained prompt in fixed order: canvas and layout, subject and relationships, medium and style, palette, material and light, typography placement, composition and hierarchy, then targeted exclusions. No headings, labels, JSON, or rationale. Budget: 550 to 900 characters (about 90 to 150 English words) and never more than 1000. When the draft runs long, cut in this order: stacked adjectives, repeated composition or placement wording, then generic quality words; keep identity, count, ownership, relationships, exact copy, the medium and style anchor, and the exclusions that block a plausible misreading.

preserve.description: Invariants that must survive a reference-image edit or inpaint. Empty for fresh generation.

avoid.description: Only plausible misreadings of this design, expressed as short clauses. Never a generic defect catalogue.

visual_qa.description: Checkable observations for reviewing the rendered image: exact wording, counts, regions, identity, material, contact, and legibility.
